# Shibumi 0.1.1-beta.10

## Summary

Beta.10 is the release candidate after the official Omarchy baseline refresh.
It keeps the Step 1D host-owned Notifications result intact and records the
forward-compatible Network action contract without beginning the native
Network cutover.

## Included

- Official Omarchy `4.0.0-1` / `v4.0.0` package and source baselines
- Immutable forward-compatibility evidence at `ed7bae4a`
- `connectKnown()` and `connectDirectly()` host action compatibility
- Permanent regression coverage for the forward Network action
- Package, source-parity, forward, Agents, suite, Health, and live validation
  gates covered by the beta.10 validation plan; exact clean-commit evidence is
  required before tagging

## Known limits

Physical multi-output, mixed-scale, hardware, and full visual-freeze gates
remain explicitly open. AUR publication remains unavailable until the package
name can be registered.
